title: Using HOBO Data Loggers for Environmental Monitoring
author: Sophie Martin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vbye2pw
materials: Open the HOBOware software (FREE download) HOBOware

steps.title: Connect logger to computer
steps.instruction: Insert the HOBO data logger firmly into the USB Base Station that is connected to the computer, ensuring the logger fits into the corresponding slot.

steps.title: Launch logger software
steps.instruction: Click the Launching icon (Icon 1) on the toolbar to open the Plot Setup window.

steps.title: Configure recording parameters
steps.instruction: In the Plot Setup window, enter a file name, select the parameters Temperature and Light Intensity, and set the recording interval (e.g., “5 seconds”).

steps.title: Start data acquisition
steps.instruction: Choose either “Start” for immediate recording or “Delayed start” for postponed recording, specifying the desired date and time, then click the corresponding button.

steps.title: Read out and plot data
steps.instruction: Click the Read out icon (Icon 2) on the toolbar, select a folder to save the data file, keep the default unit settings (Temperature in °C, Light Intensity in Lux, leave other units checked), and press the Plot button.

steps.title: Export data to Excel
steps.instruction: Click the Excel icon (Icon 12); in the dialog that appears, leave all options checked, then open the Preference/Settings icon (third icon) and set Data Export to Excel, choose “Separate date and time: No”, set Time format to 24 h, ensure “Export automatically” is unchecked, and finally click OK, then Export and Save the file.
